name: Eagle Nice (International) Holdings Limited
summary: Eagle Nice (International) Holdings Limited, an investment holding company, manufactures and trades in sportswear and garments in Mainland China, the United States, Europe, South Korea, Japan, and internationally. The company offers sportswear, such as down jackets, tracksuits, sweaters, and sports pants, etc., as well as value-added services. It also leases properties. The company serves sportwear brands. Eagle Nice (International) Holdings Limited was founded in 1993 and is headquartered in Kwai Chung, Hong Kong.
